candidates: formation-only runs (goals_v3's runs, kick-off ends) at one cell of goals_v5's T x R x N grid, the cell chosen on all 20 halves by goals_v5's 'without the whistle' key (hits, then fewest false runs, then larger T, smaller R (None last), smaller N). This is the product's candidate rule; reported: hits, candidates per match.

team rules (each names the team that kic.kick_spot: goals_v3's: the team-labelled person nearest the spot at the run's last sample
team rules (each names the team that kic.attack_end: formation.scorer_attack_end: the half holding the people's mean x over the 10-40 s before the run start conceded
team rules (each names the team that kic.spot_vote: over the run's samples, the team of the team-labelled person nearest the spot; majority over the samples where that person is within 3 m (all samples if none); ties to kick_spot
team rules (each names the team that kic.circle_count: team-labelled persons within 9.15 m of the spot summed over the run's samples; the team with more kicks off; ties to kick_spot
team rules (each names the team that kic.circle_count_last10: circle_count over the run's last 10 samples

choice: leave one match out: the rule with the most right teams on the other 9 matches' hits (ties in the order listed), scored on the held-out match's hits; pooled
bar: proposed team right on >= 0.9 of held-out hits (the owner's team bar)
also reported: each rule's right share on all hits (in-sample)
per match: hits, right teams, chosen rule
share of hits where the rule gives no team
cost: local CPU, seconds; no video, no GPU, no Kaggle
